SELECT
    `monthly___region`,
    `monthly___ordered_at`,
    `monthly___t`
FROM (
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    monthly.region AS `monthly___region`,
    DATE_TRUNC(monthly.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `monthly___ordered_at`
  FROM monthly AS monthly
  WHERE
    monthly.ordered_at BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-03-31'
  GROUP BY
    monthly.region,
    DATE_TRUNC(monthly.ordered_at, MONTH)
), _cm_monthly__amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(monthly.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `monthly___ordered_at`,
    CAST(SUM(monthly.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `monthly___amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at`
  FROM monthly AS monthly
  WHERE
    monthly.ordered_at BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-03-31'
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC(monthly.ordered_at, MONTH)
), base AS (
  SELECT
    _base.`monthly___region`,
    _base.`monthly___ordered_at`,
    _cm_monthly__amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at.`monthly___amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at` AS `monthly___amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at`
  FROM _base
  LEFT JOIN _cm_monthly__amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at
    ON _base.`monthly___ordered_at` IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_monthly__amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at.`monthly___ordered_at`
), shifted_t AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(monthly.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `monthly___ordered_at`,
    CAST(SUM(monthly.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `monthly___amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at`
  FROM monthly AS monthly
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC(monthly.ordered_at, MONTH)
), sjoin_t AS (
  SELECT
    base.`monthly___region`,
    base.`monthly___ordered_at`,
    base.`monthly___amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at`,
    shifted_t.`monthly___amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at` AS `monthly___t`
  FROM base
  LEFT JOIN shifted_t
    ON base.`monthly___ordered_at` - INTERVAL 1 MONTH IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted_t.`monthly___ordered_at`
)
SELECT
  `monthly___region`,
  `monthly___ordered_at`,
  `monthly___amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at`,
  `monthly___t`
FROM sjoin_t
) AS _outer

    monthly.ordered_at BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-03-31'
  GROUP BY
    DATETRUNC(MONTH, monthly.ordered_at)

  SELECT
    _base.[monthly___region] AS [monthly___region],
    _base.[monthly___ordered_at] AS [monthly___ordered_at],
    _cm_monthly__amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at.[monthly___amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at] AS [monthly___amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at]
  FROM _base
  LEFT JOIN _cm_monthly__amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at
    ON (
      _base.[monthly___ordered_at] = _cm_monthly__amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at.[monthly___ordered_at]
      OR (
        _base.[monthly___ordered_at] IS NULL
        AND _cm_monthly__amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at.[monthly___ordered_at] IS NULL
      )
    )
), shifted_t AS (
  SELECT
    DATETRUNC(MONTH, monthly.ordered_at) AS [monthly___ordered_at],
    CAST(SUM(monthly.amount) AS FLOAT) AS [monthly___amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at]
  FROM monthly AS monthly

      DATEADD(MONTH, -1, base.[monthly___ordered_at]) = shifted_t.[monthly___ordered_at]

      )
    )

    _stage_inner.`monthly___ordered_at` AS `ordered_at`,

  FROM (
    SELECT
      monthly.region AS `monthly___region`,
      DATE_TRUNC(monthly.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `monthly___ordered_at`,
      CAST(SUM(monthly.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `monthly___rev`
    FROM monthly AS monthly

  ) AS _stage_inner

  SELECT

    DATE_TRUNC(s1.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `s1___ordered_at`,
    SUM(s1.rev) AS `s1___rev_sum`
  FROM __slayer_stage_s1 AS s1
  WHERE
    s1.ordered_at BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-03-31'
  GROUP BY
    s1.region,
    DATE_TRUNC(s1.ordered_at, MONTH)
), _cm_s1__rev_sum_partition_by_ordered_at AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(__slayer_stage_s1.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `__slayer_stage_s1___ordered_at`,
